analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file and rule correctly fits the 2026 marks' variance components with the stations and the examiners random, counts each station's examiner stringency as error for one examiner a station in three circuits (the field's textbook decision study) and files 16 stations; the blueprint draws the same number of stations from each of the four domains every year, so a candidate's strength in a domain recurs in every form and is part of what the total mark measures, and counted as true score rather than error it puts the 2027 examination at 13.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the reliability of the final OSCE's total mark under a blueprint that fixes the stations drawn from each skill domain, a generalizability study of the 2026 marks split into candidate, candidate by domain, case specificity within domain, examiner stringency and residual variance and recombined in a decision study for single examining on the fixed blueprint, the field's own analysis of a clinical examination's reliability; with another field's nouns (megawatt-hours for marks, meters for stations) there is no content blueprint fixing what every form samples, no case specificity and no examiner, so the task stops reading the same.

the global grades in their own export beside the checklist marks

driver: The decisive quantity is how consistently a total over parts will rank units when the specification fixes how many parts come from each content area every time, so each unit's strength in an area recurs in every form and belongs to the true score; estimated from a round whose parts were drawn the same way, the analysis that treats the parts as drawn from one undivided pool counts that strength as error and overstates the number of parts a standard needs.
driver_concrete: The 2027 final OSCE's reliability on a blueprint that draws the same number of stations from each of four domains, from the 2026 marks split into candidate, candidate by domain, case specificity within domain, examiner within station and residual variance, with the candidate-by-domain variance counted as true score and the examiner's stringency as error for single examining in three circuits: 13 stations, where the textbook decision study with stations drawn from an undivided bank files 16 and single-examiner alpha keeps 12.
stump: A competent solver fits the 2026 marks' variance components with the stations and examiners random from one bank, counts the examiner's stringency as error for one examiner a station and files 16 stations; the step that lands it there is counting the candidate-by-domain variance as error, when the blueprint draws the same number of stations from each domain every year, so a candidate's domain strengths recur in every form and belong to what the total mark measures.

differentiation.task232: task232 attributes delayed outcomes to an exposure only inside a known delay window to estimate a transmission rate; task269 attributes no outcome to any period: it decomposes one clinical examination's mark variance with the blueprint's content domains as a facet and counts each candidate's domain strength as true score because every form draws the same domains
differentiation.task152: task152 books a loss that accumulates between resets apart from wear to forecast the output a replacement restores; task269 projects a reliability coefficient for the next examination from variance components, the candidate-by-domain variance kept in the true score because the blueprint fixes the domains in every form
differentiation.task260: task260 widens an interval for a mean improvement by resampling raters and items together; task269 estimates no interval: it decomposes the sources of score variance with the blueprint's domains as a fixed facet and reads the number of stations a reliability standard needs
differentiation.task239: task239 separates a group-level factor from members' own covariance carried into group averages; task269 separates each candidate's strength in a domain from the case specificity within it, and the decisive step counts that strength as true score because the blueprint fixes the domains in every form
differentiation.task257: task257 counts the latent dimensions of categorical items by correlating them as cuts of continuous views; task269 v2 decomposes one clinical examination's mark variance with the blueprint's domains as a facet and counts the candidate-by-domain variance as true score because every form draws the same domains: no dimension is counted and no item is correlated
differentiation.task269 (v1): v1 counted the examiner stringency the 2026 sitting shared across candidates as error under single examining; v2 keeps that as the field's standard step and turns on the other side of the decomposition: the candidate-by-domain variance the fixed blueprint makes true score, which the textbook decision study counts as error

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how consistently a total over several scored parts will rank units once each part is scored by one scorer drawn from a pool and different units meet different scorers, estimated from a round in which the same two scorers scored every unit on each part; in that round a scorer's own level was shared by every unit and so never moved a ranking, so the agreement between parts, each scorer's marks taken alone and a decomposition that keeps the scorers shared all leave it out, while under the new arrangement it adds to every unit's error, so the number of parts has to come from the round's sources of variance recombined with the scorers' levels counted as error.
lineage.architecture: v1 (Callowfield University's 2027 final-year OSCE, single-examined in three parallel circuits once Fennabeg Clinical School's cohort joins: the number of stations its total marks need for the school's reliability standard of 0.80, projected from the 2026 sitting's dual-examined marks with each station's examiner stringency counted as error)
lineage.stump: A competent solver computes the 2026 sitting's reliability on single-examiner marks (alpha across the stations, or a generalizability study with the examiners crossed with the candidates) and steps it to more stations by Spearman-Brown, filing the current 12 stations as enough; the step that lands it there is reading each examiner's leniency as 2026 showed it, a shift every candidate at that station shared, when in 2027's parallel circuits different candidates meet different examiners and the leniency spread between examiners becomes error in every candidate's total.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 (Gate F): the cold reader split the 2026 marks into candidates by examiners within stations and counted the stringency as error for one examiner a station, committing the golden call and every ask figure; the judge DETERMINISTIC with Gates G and H passing
